text:
maria: Quick question — if we mix header-based canary routing with session stickiness (cookie/user_id), are we introducing sampling bias for small cohorts?
henry: Yep. header overrides win early in path, then cookie stickiness can pull traffic back to baseline depending on when we set it.
anya: Can you sketch the flow you're thinking of? header->splitter->session? Or session first?
maria: Header check -> route split -> set session cookie when routed to canary. But realized users who hit other gateways might never get cookie set.
sam: That matches concerns from last quarter when tenant-level proxies pre-populated headers. Small tenants ended up never sampled.
anya: Two options: 1) make routing deterministic via hashed user id + per-tenant seed so splits are stable. 2) sample at the ingress (sticky assignment) and propagate an assignment header downstream.
maria: I like #2 because it's explicit. We could add x-redwood-assignment: "canary-v2" and honor it across services. But need a secure signing or TTL.
henry: Agreed. If we set a signed assignment token we avoid accidental overrides. Example header: `x-rw-assign: v2.signed(eyJ...)` with expiry claim.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-propagation-middleware v1.2 -> staging at 2025-03-12 15:00 UTC
sam: Telemetry question — console split graph currently shows route-config % not observed user assignment. We should surface both intended split and observed assignments (by assignment header + final route).
anya: +1. Also show drifting metric: fraction of assigned users who actually saw canary responses (due to upstream proxies/overrides).
maria: UX: add an option on rollout to "propagate assignment header" and "use deterministic seeding". Default to propagate + signed token.
henry: Implementation note: hashing on user_id should use tenant_id || user_id || rollout_id to avoid cross-tenant bleed. Also store seed in rollout config.
sam: Also need quota interaction: if canary routes have separate rate limits, assignment header should be checked before quota evaluation or else quotas will reject assigned traffic.
anya: Action items:
- Henry: prototype signed assignment header middleware (staging) — due Tue
- Sam: dashboard panels for intended vs observed split + drift metric — due Wed
- Maria: add rollout UI toggles and docs PR — due Fri
maria: Thanks all. tagging @anya for telemetry design follow-up :thumbsup:
